FN-XICDZE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 502
Committee: Ports, Waterways and Intermodal Sponsor: Representative Jennifer Fidler
Transit
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 502 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency (ALEA) by providing for the oversight and maintenance of navigational
markers on certain waters of the state through the establishment of a uniform system of
permitting such markers, in accordance with federal law.
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of counties or municipalities that elect to
place such markers, by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to procure, install, and
maintain approved navigational markers.
